booking.text: Hi, do you have anything for 2 people from 12 to 15 December?

Hi! Thanks for reaching out to Ewa Stays 😊

For 2 guests, 12 to 15 December (3 nights), we have one apartment free:

*1-bedroom, Lekki Phase 1*: ₦195,000 total (₦65,000/night)

The Studio and the 2-bedroom are already booked for those dates.

All our apartments have 24-hour power, Wi-Fi, AC, a fully equipped kitchen and a parking space. Check-in is from 2pm and check-out is by 12 noon.

Want me to book it for you? I'll just need your full name and email address.
Yes please! Is there constant light? I work from home

Yes, there is! The apartment has 24-hour power from an inverter and a generator, so you'll always have light. There's Wi-Fi too, so you can work from home without any problem 💻

To book the 1-bedroom for 12 to 15 December, please send me:
- Your full name
- Your email address (your Paystack receipt goes here)
